name: cryptic-exon-q1: name the gene carrying the cryptic exon
description: CompBioBench cryptic-exon-q1, verbatim, against a pinned dataset revision. Tier 3, live Galaxy. The input is staged into a clean history and nothing else is prescribed: no tools, no steps, no plan shape. Graded the way the benchmark grades it, on the final HGNC symbol. Hold the huggingface.co URL, never the CDN URL it redirects to: that one is signed and expires.
inputs: I have a bulk human RNA-seq fastq file cryptic.exon.q1.fq.gz. There is exactly one highly expressed coding gene that has a cryptic exon in it formed by two novel junctions. Report the HGNC gene symbol (uppercase) for that gene.
